newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAFRICAN AIRLINE TO LINK UP WITH SABENA - PAPER.
newsitem.headline: SAFRICAN AIRLINE TO LINK UP WITH SABENA - PAPER.

text.p: South African domestic airline Nationwide Air is expected to link up with Belgian flagship carrier Sabena, Business Day newspaper said on Thursday.
Citing unnamed industry sources, the paper said the details of the deal are expected to be announced later this week.

However, Nationwide general manager Hugo Smit would not name the carrier his firm is striking a deal with. "We are negotiating a very close co-operation agreement with a European carrier, but we will keep our autonomy on our domestic side," he told the newspaper.
Nationwide has 11 BAC 1-11 aircraft, two Boeing 727s and five King Air aircraft on flights from Johannesburg to Cape Town, George and Port Elizabeth.
